svg.title: Acadamark interpreter pipeline: run order versus dependency structure
svg.desc: The ten mdast plugins shown in registration order, colored by what shared state they touch, with the real dependency edges drawn alongside. Two independent chains — citations and cross-references — are interleaved in run order but do not depend on each other.
